description.value:
Using Tinker's Tools or another type of Artisan's Tools you are proficient with, you can take a Magic action to create a Reanimated Companion through the power of necromancy and science, in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. You decide its appearance; your choices don't affect its game statistics. The companion is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys you. It lasts until you finish a Long Rest or take a Magic action to dismiss it, when it harmlessly collapses into a pile of viscera; if you die, it immediately drops to 0 Hit Points and dies (triggering its Death Burst).

Once you create a companion, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest or expend a spell slot to create one. You can have only one companion at a time.

The Companion in Combat. In combat, the companion acts during your turn. It can move and take its Reaction on its own, but the only action it takes is the Dodge action unless you take a Bonus Action to command it to take another action. If you have the Incapacitated condition, it acts on its own and isn't limited to the Dodge action.

Reanimated Companion. Medium Undead, Neutral. AC 10 + your Intelligence modifier. Hit Points 5 + five times your Artificer level (Hit Dice: d8s equal to your Artificer level). Speed 30 ft. STR 11, DEX 10, CON 16, INT 4, WIS 10, CHA 6. Resistances Necrotic, Poison; Immunities Lightning; Charmed, Exhaustion, Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft. It understands the languages you know, and its Proficiency Bonus equals yours. Death Burst: when it dies, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d4 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Lightning Absorption: Lightning damage restores Hit Points to it instead. Dreadful Swipe: melee attack using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft., 1d4 plus your Intelligence modifier Necrotic damage, and the target can't take Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Foundry Note

Restore the use when you expend a spell slot to create another companion.
